usedFor: MSG91 sends messages, LeadConnector holds contacts, and “When an SMS is confirmed as delivered” can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new voice call is made or received” in MSG91, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: It creates the contact or updates it if it already exists, so repeat callers stay one contact.

watchOut: “New Call Completed” in MSG91 is polling, so tags added with “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” arrive after a short delay.
